skills.name: Smoke Blossom (煙華)
skills.line: Do you like this firework display I put on just for you?
skills.description: A firework blossoms from SP Enenra's misty smoke to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Shadowlike (如影)
skills.line: The celebration is short-staffed, so you're needed! Don't refuse my offer!
skills.description: Exclusive effect. When SP Enenra receives damage from enemies, and if she is not immobile, she she becomes an Incorporeal Smoke (can trigger a max of 2 times before her next turn). ;Upon Usage :SP Enenra becomes an Incorporeal Smoke, and creates a shield to protect all non-summoned allies that can absorb damage equal to 19% of her max HP, lasts for 2 turns. ;Incorporeal Smoke (煙霧無形) : :'''Buff, Mark''': While in this state she becomes resistant to control effects, debuffs and damage from a single enemy skill. Upon resisting, this effect is removed to increase her move bar by 15%.

upgrades.text: Absorption for shield created upon usage increases to 22%.

While she's an Incorporeal Smoke, for all non-summoned allies, when they receive damage she creates a shield to protect them that can absorb damage equal to 15% of the damage received, lasts for 2 turns.
Absorption for shield created upon usage increases to 25%.
'''Upper Hand''': Automatically becomes an Incorporeal Smoke at the start of battle.

skills.name: Nightsky's Splendour (夜幕華彩)
skills.line: Let's make the firework show more lively!
skills.description: SP Enenra decorates the night sky with splendid colors and puts on a firework display to launch a 2-strike attack on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 51% of her ATK with each strike. Then inflicts a final strike on a targeted enemy, dealing damage equal to 91% of her ATK and has a 58% base chance of Morphing them into a Smoke Phantom, lasts for 1 turn. ;Smoke Phantom (烟之鬼) : :SP Enenra's Morph effect. Unable to take actions, shikigami's passive skill loses effect, cannot be dispelled. Exclusive effect: When the Morph effect expires, inflicts all enemies with damage equal to 49% of her ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage for the final strike increases to 114%.
While she's an Incorporeal Smoke, and if no enemy is Morphed into a Smoke Phantom, base chance increases to 72%.
Damage for the final strike increases to 131%.
Final strike ignores the enemy's souls and passive effects.

bio.condition: With SP Enenra win 30 times in PVN zones.
